proves: A packet whose first byte is 0xAB instead of 0xAA is not answered at all: no error reply, no result code, only a 1505 ms transfer timeout.

request.checksumAlgorithm: LE16 sum of bytes 0..45 inclusive (HIDC included)

warning: THIS PACKET WEDGED THE DEVICE. After it, the bulk OUT endpoint NAKed every subsequent 48-byte write for about 24 minutes (16:01:10 to 16:25:20 UTC), including valid frames, before recovering by a means that was not observed. Host-side recovery (abort/flush/reset pipe, SET_INTERFACE, CLEAR_FEATURE(HALT), SET_CONFIGURATION, libusb_reset_device) did not restore it. Do not reproduce this test on a live AIO; the safe conclusion is already established: never emit a packet that does not start with AA 2E.
